cardEffects:
[Main] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text from your hand with the play cost reduced by 3. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts would leave the battle area other than in battle, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [Examon] in the hand.
name: Unleash the Dragon Gene

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT20-093 (2025/01/24, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: A Digimon card with the text "DRACOMON" or a Digimon card with the text "EXAMON".
rulings.question: Which cards can be played by this card's [Main] effect?

rulings.answer: A Digimon card with the text "DRACOMON" or a Digimon card with the text "EXAMON".
rulings.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when any card leaves?

rulings.answer: It refers to cards with the specified word or icon included in "name, trait, effect, inherited effect, <Overflow X>, jogress, digivolution requirements, burst digivolution". For example, a card with the text "Knightmon" refers to a card whose name is "Dark Knightmon" or whose effect says "Knightmon".
rulings.question: What do you mean by "cards with text?"

rulings.answer: No, they do not leave the Battle Area. DNA digivolves digivolve as a new Digimon, so it is a different Digimon than the one that leaves.
rulings.question: If two Digimon including the leaving Digimon digivolved by the "Delay" effect of this card, does the Digimon that digivolved DNA digivolves leave the Battle Area?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Dracomon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
